# Nuxt UI Development Guidelines

The UI rules for this repository live in `AGENTS.md` at the repository root, under "UI": Nuxt UI components, Solar icons, light and dark mode, Vue file conventions, and lining up text beside icons and inside buttons and badges with the `cap-center` utility. Follow them whenever you work on a `.vue` or `.ts` file.

## Copilot specifics

- The Nuxt UI MCP server in `.mcp.json` provides the component docs (`get-component`), search (`search-components`), examples (`get-example`) and icon search (`search-icons`).
